module: MCP tools for the environment: read and set the time of day and astronomical parameters (latitude, longitude, date, UTC offset, celestial profile) via core_environment. Only available in a level.
notes: time is normalized 0..1 (0 or 1 = midnight, 0.5 = noon).
set_time_of_day reads the current table, only modifies the provided fields, then reapplies it in full.
dstRule: auto, eu, us, au or none (according to the schema).

schemas.desc: Schemas of the tools get_time_of_day and set_time_of_day.

get_time_of_day.desc: Returns core_environment.getTimeOfDay() as JSON: time, play, dayLength, startTime, latitude, longitude, date, utcOffset, dstRule, celestialProfile.

set_time_of_day.desc: Modifies the time and the provided astronomical fields then calls core_environment.setTimeOfDay.

args.desc: {time?: 0..1, play?: boolean, dayLength?: number real s, startTime?: number, latitude?: number°, longitude?: number°, year?, month?, day?, utcOffset?: number h, dstRule?: string, celestialProfile?: string}
